timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

declare.en: If this unit is not in combat, pick the closest enemy unit to it to be the target. If 2 or more enemy units are tied to be the closest, you can pick which is the target. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.

effect.en: This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of the target. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If it does so, this unit has charged.
This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 3" of:

• An objective or terrain feature that has a friendly **Pestilent Pollutant**, or

• A **POLLUTED** terrain feature (see Gelgus Pust’s warscroll), or
• An objective you control.

declare.en: This unit’s **Pestilent Pollutants** are tokens. This unit has 2 **Pestilent Pollutants**. Pick an objective or terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Place 1 of this unit’s **Pestilent Pollutants** next to the target. If both of this unit’s **Pestilent Pollutants** are already on the battlefield, pick 1 of them, remove it from the battlefield and place it next to the target instead.
If this unit has 2 models and would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, 1 model in this unit is slain.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Plague Scion*.

effect.en:
You gain a number of **tally points** equal to the current battle round number.

During the battle round, you can spend your **tally points**. For each **tally point** you spend, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll, 1 save roll or 1 ward roll for a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.

At the end of the battle round, any unspent **tally points** are lost.

For the rest of the phase, this terrain feature has a Move characteristic of 3" and can immediately move 3". It cannot move through or end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units and it cannot end that move on an objective or another terrain feature.

**Designer’s Note:** *This terrain feature cannot use* **MOVE**, **RUN**, **RETREAT** *or* **CHARGE** *abilities.*
Friendly **ROTBRINGERS** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this terrain feature

Each time a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this terrain feature uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 1 additional rally roll of D6. If that unit is a non-**HERO** unit, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6 instead.

This rule varies depending on the battlepack selected for your army:

**General's Handbook 2024-25**
Subtract 1 from **hit rolls** for attacks that target a unit that is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless that unit **charged** this turn or has the **FLY** keyword.

**General's Handbook 2025-26**
Subtract 1 from **hit rolls** for attacks that target a unit that is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless that unit **charged** this turn or has the **FLY** keyword.

**General's Handbook 2026-27**
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target a unit that is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless that unit charged this turn or has the **FLY** keyword.

This rule varies depending on the battlepack selected for your army:

**General's Handbook 2024-25**
Models cannot move across, be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

**General's Handbook 2025-26**
Models cannot move across, be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

**General's Handbook 2026-27**
Models cannot move across, be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

wargear.en:
**The following universal terrain abilities apply to this terrain feature (Terrain, 1.2):**

**Cover, Impassable**

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature.

effect.en:
You and your opponent must roll off. Add this unit’s Control characteristic to your roll and the target’s Control characteristic to your opponent’s roll. If your roll is higher, apply the corresponding effect:

• If the target is a **HERO** or **MONSTER**, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between your roll and your opponent’s roll.

• If the target is a non-**HERO** non‑**MONSTER** unit, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Gathoblyt’s Fanged Maw** is 3.

declare.en: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en: This unit gains 1 **leech point** for the rest of the battle. Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **CORE** ability or command, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any damage points were allocated to the target by this ability, **Heal (1)** this unit.

For each enemy unit that was in combat with this unit this turn and was destroyed this turn, this unit gains D3 **leech points** for the rest of the battle. Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to this unit’s Control characteristic for each **leech point** it currently has.

timing.en: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase

declare.en: Pick a terrain feature within 6" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: The target is considered by you to be **POLLUTED** for the rest of the battle.

declare.en: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.

effect.en:
Roll a dice for each target. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:

• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
• Subtract 1 from the target’s Control characteristic.

While a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit is wholly within 6" of a **POLLUTED** terrain feature, each time that unit uses or is the target of an ability that would heal 1 or more damage points, add 1 to the number of damage points healed.

While an enemy unit is within 6" of a **POLLUTED** terrain feature, each time that unit uses or is the target of an ability that would heal 1 or more damage points, subtract 1 from the number of damage points healed, to a minimum of 0.

declare.en: Pick each enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the targets.

effect.en: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

declare.en: Pick an objective that is contested by this unit to be the target.

effect.en: The target is **seeded with rot** for the rest of the battle.
When using the ‘Blessed by the Plaguefather’ ability, if you choose to infect an enemy unit, you can pick an enemy unit that is contesting an objective that is **seeded with rot**.

wargear.en:

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

declare.en: If this unit is damaged, pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.

effect.en: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

declare.en: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON** unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.

effect.en: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of this unit or a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

declare.en: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en: The target has the **DISEASED** keyword.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Colossal Blight Weapons** is 3.

declare.en: Pick a friendly **Beast of Nurgle** unit that has been destroyed.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 3+, set up a replacement unit wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

If there is no more than 1 friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield, you can set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.

declare.en: Pick a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** to be the target.

effect.en: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.
This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

declare.en: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.

effect.en: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
This unit has a coherency range of 2".
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit while it is contesting an objective you control.

timing.en: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

effect.en: Pick a friendly **Plaguebearers** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

effect.en: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Gnarlrod** is 3.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

declare.en: If this unit charged this phase, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

declare.en: Pick each enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy targets, then pick each friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit within 18" of this unit to be the friendly targets. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en:
Inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy target and **Heal (1)** each friendly target.

Then, until the start of your next turn, if an ability would heal or return any slain models to an enemy unit while they are within 18" of this unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.
Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE**  units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Gnarlrod** is 3.

declare.en: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en:
Add 3" to the range of this unit’s ‘Befouled Rainfall’ ability for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy unit within range of that ability.
Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

units.notes_en: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

declare.en: Pick a visible friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit or a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
If you picked a friendly unit to be the target, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, add 2 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

If you picked an enemy unit to be the target, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, until the start of your next turn, while this unit is on the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target:

• Each time the target ends a move further from this unit than it was at the start of the move, after the ability used by the target has been resolved.
• Each time the target is removed from the battlefield and set up again on the battlefield further from this unit than it was before it was removed, after the ability used by the target has been resolved.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

declare.en: Pick a friendly **Plaguebearers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
Roll a D6. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

***Tally of Blows:*** Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
***Recorded Stamina:*** Add 5 to the target’s control score.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

effect.en: The target cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities until the start of your next turn.
